items.title: Commencement
notes:
A meeting of City Council was held at (time) this date, chaired by Mayor B. Vrbanovic. Notice of this meeting had been previously given to all members of Council by the City Clerk pursuant to Chapter 25 (Council Procedure) of the Municipal Code.

The meeting began with a Land Acknowledgement given by the Mayor.

items.title: Disclosure of Pecuniary Interest and the General Nature Thereof
Notice All-Council Meeting / Region of Waterloo & Area Municipalities - For Information
notes: Mayor and Members of Kitchener City Council have been invited to participate in a joint meeting with the Councils of the Regional Municipality of Waterloo and all Area Municipalities within the Region of Waterloo on Friday June 13, 2025 anticipated to begin at 2:30 p.m., further notice of the meeting will be published at www.regionofwaterloo.ca.

items.title: Mayoral Business and Updates - Mayor B. Vrbanovic
Recess and Reconvene
notes: The Special Council meeting then recessed at 4:04 p.m. and reconvened at 7:28 p.m., chaired by Mayor B. Vrbanovic, with all members present.

items.title: Contract Negotiations (Labour relations or employee negotiations - Section 239 (2) (d)), COR-2025-262
Solicitor Client privilege regarding potential settlement of a litigation matter (Solicitor-client privilege and Potential litigation - Section 239 (2) (e) and (f)), COR-2025-272
To confirm all actions and proceedings of the Council for June 2, 2025.
Adjournment
notes: On motion the meeting adjourned at 7:30 p.m.

motions.text: "That an in-camera meeting of City Council be held immediately following the special council meeting this date to consider four items including; a matter of solicitor-client privilege, a potential land disposition matter, a labour relations and negotiation matter and a solicitor-client privilege and potential litigation matter as authorized by Sections 239 (2) (c) (d) (e) and (f) of the Municipal Act, 2001, respectively."
motions.text_html: "That an in-camera meeting of City Council be held immediately following the special council meeting this date to consider four items including; a matter of solicitor-client privilege, a potential land disposition matter, a labour relations and negotiation matter and a solicitor-client privilege and potential litigation matter as authorized by Sections 239 (2) (c) (d) (e) and (f) of the Municipal Act, 2001, respectively."

motions.item_title: Contract Negotiations (Labour relations or employee negotiations - Section 239 (2) (d)), COR-2025-262
motions.text: "That the terms and conditions contained in the Memorandum of Settlement dated May 14, 2025, to establish the 2025-2029 Collective Agreement with IBEW 636 be approved; and further, That the Mayor and the Clerk be authorized to execute documentation arising there from."

motions.text: “That the General Manager of Infrastructure Services be authorized to approve any settlement in Court File No. CV-21-00001134-0000 in accordance with the direction given in-camera on June 2, 2025, and to the satisfaction of the City Solicitor; and further, That the General Manager of Infrastructure Services be authorized to execute any minutes of settlement pertaining to an approved settlement in Court File No. CV-21-00001134-0000, to the satisfaction of the City Solicitor”.
